color_dna_stack.name: Colour DNA Columns
color_dna_stack.description: Eight static gallery studies at 5-7.4 m: Mondrian, Albers, Memphis, tall Bauhaus, blues, an elongated ps07_kras_rainbow, and two combined stacks. Reuses primitive_stack.build with copied source configs. Explicit Kraš shaft overrides and per-part height normalization are saved in studies.json. Convex collision per primitive. Labels stay at 1.2 m, beyond each silhouette. No animation or physical balance simulation.
dev_themes: Use existing gallery DNA as compositional vocabulary
Raise a striped pedestal into a column
Combine several configurations into one vertical body
color_dna_stack.qfep_connection: A fixed alphabet permits different bodies when dimensions, ordering and colour assignment are composed. Monumental height and recognizable styles arise from explicit parameter choices; the scene does not claim physical balance or reconstruct the cited artworks.
color_dna_stack.note: Gallery source snapshots, source hashes and current map validation: doc/space/color-dna-columns-2026-09-17/.
